notes.title: The Rule Of SHE is OUT NOW!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone!  [/p][p] [/p][p]Our game "The Rule Of SHE" is officially launching on Steam today![/p][p] [/p][p]"The Rule Of SHE" is a role-playing game centered around exploring "her." Each scenario presents you with different rules that must be followed - break them, and dire consequences await. By following the guidance of these rules, you'll uncover the deeper secrets of this world and discover the hidden truth behind all these mysterious regulations.  When you truly understand and gain insight into this world of strange tales, you'll be ready to complete your reincarnation.  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2952970/SHE/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Feel free to leave any questions in the comments. Thank you all for your support![/p]

notes.title: Join us in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continued support and attention to the game! We’re thrilled to announce the participation of "The Rule of: SHE" in the Steam Next Festival from February 24th to March 3rd at 10:00 am PT. Welcome to participate in the demo!

If you encounter any problems while playing the demo, you are welcome to join our Discord to share your game experience and suggestions with us!
